title: Guest Payments Schedule: Payment Plans and Failed Collections for Stays (Guest Reservations)
content:
# Guest Payments Schedule

How a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category may be paid depends on its cancellation policy. Every stay records its payment plan at booking: paid in full, pay-part-now (a deposit now and the balance later), or monthly installments.

## Plans by cancellation policy

| Cancellation policy | Pay-part-now available | Deposit collected as installment 1 | Minimum lead from booking date to check-in | Balance (installment 2) collected | Monthly installments | Nights per monthly installment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Flexible | Yes | 50.00% of every component | 21 calendar days | 14 calendar days before check-in | No | 0 |
| Moderate | Yes | 50.00% of every component | 21 calendar days | 14 calendar days before check-in | No | 0 |
| Limited | Yes | 50.00% of every component | 28 calendar days | 21 calendar days before check-in | No | 0 |
| Firm | Yes | 50.00% of every component | 42 calendar days | 35 calendar days before check-in | No | 0 |
| Strict | No | 0.00% | 0 | 0 | No | 0 |
| Super Strict 30 Days | No | 0.00% | 0 | 0 | No | 0 |
| Super Strict 60 Days | No | 0.00% | 0 | 0 | No | 0 |
| Long-Term | No | 0.00% | 0 | 0 | Yes | 30 |

Figures of 0 or 0.00% record that the plan is unavailable on that policy. Nights per monthly installment is the number of nights each monthly installment covers, 0 where monthly installments are not used.

## Failed collections (all eight policies)

| Setting | Value for Flexible, Moderate, Limited, Firm, Strict, Super Strict 30 Days, Super Strict 60 Days and Long-Term |
|---|---|
| Automatic retries of a failed scheduled collection | 2 |
| Failed-payment grace period | 48 elapsed hours after the first failed collection attempt of an installment, after which a still-unpaid confirmed stay is cancelled for non-payment |

## Dated illustration (hypothetical stay)

A hypothetical Limited stay checks in on 2026-08-30 and is booked on 2026-08-01, 29 calendar days ahead. That meets the 28-day minimum lead, so pay-part-now may be chosen: installment 1 collects 50.00% of every component, and the balance falls due 21 calendar days before check-in, on 2026-08-09. Booked on 2026-08-03 instead, 27 days ahead, the same stay could not use pay-part-now.
